name: Edward Le
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Renton, Washington
about: With over 25 years of dedicated service to clients across Washington State, Edward K. Le has established himself as a leading figure in personal injury law. Throughout his career, he has successfully recovered more than $200 million for his clients, including over 50 cases with recoveries exceeding $1,000,000.*

Known for handling high-stakes and catastrophic injury cases, Mr. Le specializes in complex legal matters involving traumatic brain injury, spinal cord injuries, amputations, disfigurement from car accidents, wrongful death, dog bites, construction accidents, dangerous premises, and defective products. Mr. Le’s expertise and commitment to his clients are underscored by his board certification in civil trial law from the National Board of Trial Advocacy, a prestigious designation held by fewer than 10 attorneys in Washington State.**

His exemplary legal abilities have earned him consistent recognition as one of the top 100 lawyers by Super Lawyers and Washington State Law & Politics for the past decade. Additionally, he has received the AV Preeminent* rating from Martindale-Hubbell, a mark of distinction that reflects the exceptional respect he commands among his peers. As a member of the Million Dollar Advocates Forum and the Multi-Million Dollar Advocates Forum, Mr. Le has been acknowledged by the National Trial Lawyers Association as one of the top 100 attorneys in Washington and has garnered a perfect 10.0 "Superb" rating on Avvo. A seasoned litigator, Mr. Le has conducted numerous trials and arbitrated over 100 personal injury cases across Washington and beyond.

He is a sought-after speaker, sharing his insights on trial advocacy, ethics, discovery, and evidentiary issues with esteemed organizations, including the Washington State Bar, Washington State Association of Justice, American Association of Justice, and the National Trial Lawyers Association. Additionally, he has served as an expert witness on ethics and fees and has been appointed as a neutral arbitrator in more than 80 cases, often assisting other attorneys as a trial consultant. With a steadfast commitment to justice and a proven track record of success, Edward K. Le continues to advocate for those in need, making a significant impact on the lives of his clients and the legal community as a whole.

He is also active in his local community and has been awarded the Pro Bono Publico award by the Bar over the last 10 years. His hobbies include philanthrophy, reading, chess, photography, and volunteering in local organizations.
*All cases are different and valued differently depending on the circumstances

** The Supreme Court of Washington does not recognize certification of specialties in the practice of law and that the certificate, award, or recognition is not a requirement to practice law in the state of Washi ngton.
